career_spells.role: Police officer in uniform/plain-clothes duties; detective; detective sergeant
career_spells.evidence_note: Official month range retained. In his first speech Batt says he was a detective for more than 11 years; this is a nested role and does not supply exact sub-period boundaries. Council office commenced in 2008; police leave, reduced hours or continued substantive service during overlap are unverified. Contemporary indexed resignation report places departure after re-election as Division8 councillor; compatible with later2012 exit but insufficient to establish active service or leave throughout2008–12. Original2018 speech describes five years of post-academy uniform/plain-clothes work in Gladstone and Brisbane before return to Bundaberg and detective work. Rounded five-year recollection is nested role context, not exact sub-period boundaries or continuous full-time proof.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, employer control and/or substantive full-time status remain insufficient for a duration calculation; unknown is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Queensland Police Service / Bundaberg PCYC — employing arrangement unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: Manager role predates council election and is described as part of police career. Treat as potentially nested/seconded police work, not extra additive employment or assumed nonprofit payroll. Council 2010–11 report states more than two years of PCYC management before first election; Batt's first speech independently places him as the PCYC manager in 2007 when he attended a Rotary exchange. These establish duration context and a 2007 snapshot, not precise appointment/cessation or payroll boundaries. Original2018 speech explains PCYC appointment as a break from plain-clothes duties after difficult investigations; no unpaid employment break or different payroll employer established by that wording.

career_spells.role: Disaster Management Officer / Community Resilience and Disaster Management Coordinator
career_spells.evidence_note: Staff employment between state and federal parliamentary service; municipality is publicly controlled. A 2024 council publication identifies him as Disaster Management Officer delivering Get Ready preparedness messaging; the official parliamentary biography uses Community Resilience and Disaster Management Coordinator for the July2021–April2025 interval. Batt's later description of five years is approximate and is not used to override those month boundaries. Hours and leave remain unverified. Re-read first speech on 2026-10-02: he explicitly reports working full time preparing for Tropical Cyclone Alfred while deciding to nominate in 2025. This proves full-time status at that point, not uninterrupted full-time work throughout July2021–April2025.

research_notes: Follow up police hours/leave during 2008–2012 council overlap, PCYC payroll/secondment dates, council staff full-time status and exact boundaries, earlier Woolworths dates and any employment between October 2020 and July 2021. Board roles remain separate from substantive employment.

Police January 1989–July 2012 and council staff July 2021–April 2025 are month precision only. Do not turn tenure or detective rank into full-time evidence. Do not count council elected office, disaster portfolio or overlapping PCYC duties twice.

First speech also describes childhood cricket-ground maintenance and later sport, church, school and nonprofit board volunteering. These do not establish paid employment. Deferred human-movement study is not a completed degree or job.

Searched parliamentary biographies, first speech, member and party sites, council annual reports, PCYC/police records, IMPACT employer material, public professional profiles and full-time/leave terms. LinkedIn content did not load; council 2017–18 PDF and university-hosted research PDF returned 403; police website search reported robots restriction. No bypass attempted. Annual-report indexed evidence is labelled as such.

ABC's broad pre-council police narrative cannot resolve the 2008–2012 overlap. Namesake barrister, academic, overseas police officer and veterinarian results were rejected. No reliable work-hour evidence retrieved. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; future leads include historical police/PCYC personnel notices and council position records.

2026-10-02 materially enriched: identified explicit early2025 council full-time statement previously missed in first speech, two police qualifications and Across the Waves governance. Historical2010–11 primary report retrieved;2016–17 indexed. Police resignation indexed report narrows context to re-election but cannot resolve2008–12 leave. LinkedIn direct open returned Internal Error. Next leads: council appointment/leave notices2021–25, police service/PCYC secondment record; retain unknown interim work and retail dates. Existing note that no full-time evidence was found describes prior review only.

First speech paragraph beginning The silver lining explicitly reports six months off work after the2020 election loss, with church volunteering. This partly explains the2020–21 gap; precise start/end and coverage of all months before July2021 appointment remain unknown. Do not invent a continuous unemployment or paid-leave interval.

2026-10-03 follow-up: primary council material adds a contemporaneous October2024 Disaster Management Officer snapshot and preparedness duties; Batt's first speech supplies more-than-11-years detective duration and a 2007 PCYC-manager snapshot. His later five-year council shorthand conflicts with the official July2021–April2025 interval and is treated as rounded narrative. No police leave/hours, PCYC employing arrangement, continuous council full-time status, campaign leave or retail dates were located. Material duties/duration enrichment only; blocked status and null totals retained.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Fresh parliamentary qualifications list adds four training credentials with named providers, preserving distinctions from the earlier policing diploma. Primary2008–2009 council report index adds Wide Bay Volunteers committee involvement and North Bundaberg Lions/Bundy in Bloom president roles; September2021 parish bulletin index adds Parish Stewardship Council membership. PDF access failures are explicitly labelled; no full report/page verification claimed. Police leave-of-absence and council full-time/appointment searches found no service-hours continuity or leave evidence beyond existing2025 full-time snapshot. New governance and study are excluded; do not convert police medals, senior rank or contemporary training to continuous full-time years.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Targeted both search engines for QPS/council2008–12 overlap, PCYC appointment/payroll and2021 council appointment/leave. Historical2009–10 council report distinguishes Batt as elected disaster spokesperson from Bill Daniels as full-time SES employee; that hours label is not Batt’s. Modern leave-from-Parliament reports are not police employment leave. No attributable individual service-hours/secondment instrument recovered; US retired corrections officer, OECD director and Australian barrister namesakes rejected. Existing exact month chronology, early2025 full-time snapshot and six-month break retained without continuous full-time calculation. Next substantive lead remains QPS service/PCYC secondment and council personnel documentation.
